blocks.text: 根据 AI 安全公司 Norforge 的调查结果，一名黑客利用一支主要由 AI 代理组成的“大军”入侵了 100 多个网站，这些代理大多自主运作。虽然 Norforge 没有点名攻击目标，但路透社报道称，受害者包括 John Deere、SharkNinja 和 Cummins 等公司。

blocks.text: 随着技术日益先进，人们对 AI 驱动的网络安全入侵的担忧不断加剧，黑客利用这些工具发动大规模攻击。与此同时，失控的 AI 代理在逃离测试环境后也在自行发动攻击。

也在自行发动攻击。

blocks.text: Norforge 的研究人员通过 Cairn 上暴露的工作内容发现了这些攻击。Cairn 是一个开源 AI 平台，自称为“通用问题求解引擎”。借助 Cairn，用户可以为 AI 代理设定起点和终点，代理在推进任务时会记录其进展。然而，正如 Norforge 所指出的，黑客也可以利用该工具，通过 AI 代理来策划网络攻击。

blocks.text: 据路透社报道，入侵 100 多个网站的黑客是 Norforge 发现的暴露 Cairn 实例中“最活跃”的一个，他对位于美国、加拿大、澳大利亚和日本的公司发动了攻击。据路透社报道，这名攻击者用不到 100 个汉字列出了“首选入侵策略”，成功入侵耗时约 23 小时。总体而言，Nordforge 发现了 20 多个“可能具有恶意”的暴露 Cairn 实例。

blocks.text: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn’t name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins.

blocks.text: Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown as the technology grows more advanced, with hackers using the tools to carry out large-scale attacks. At the same time, rogue AI agents are carrying out attacks of their own after escaping from testing environments.

inlines.text: Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches
have grown as the technology grows more advanced, with hackers using the tools to carry out large-scale attacks. At the same time,
rogue AI agents are carrying out attacks
of their own after escaping from testing environments.

blocks.text: Researchers at Norforge uncovered the attacks through exposed work on Cairn, an open-source AI platform that describes itself as a “general-purpose problem-solving engine.” With Cairn, users set a start and end point for the AI agents, which document their progress as they move forward with the task. However, as noted by Norforge, hackers can also use the tool to orchestrate cyberattacks using AI agents.

describes itself

as a “general-purpose problem-solving engine.” With Cairn, users set a start and end point for the AI agents, which document their progress as they move forward with the task. However, as noted by Norforge, hackers can also use the tool to orchestrate cyberattacks using AI agents.

blocks.text: The hacker who broke into more than 100 sites was the “most active” among the exposed Cairn instances discovered by Norforge, waging attacks on companies based in the US, Canada, Australia, and Japan, as reported by Reuters. This attacker laid out “preferred intrusion tactics” using fewer than 100 Chinese characters, with successful breaches taking about 23 hours, according to Reuters. Overall, Nordforge found more than 20 exposed Cairn instances that are “likely malicious.”

blocks.text: In a statement to Reuters, a John Deere spokesperson said there is “no indication that ​sensitive information was accessed” as a result of the attack, while Cummins said it’s “investigating the report of a potential cyber-attack on a website operated by one of our third-party vendors.”

blocks.text: Meanwhile, SharkNinja says the breach impacted a standalone site with product support information, and that it has contained the threat. John Deere, Cumms, and SharkNinja didn’t immediately respond to The Verge’s request for comment.
